intents.answer: FreshFind does not have verified live opening hours. Trading days and hours vary by trader, so please confirm with the market before travelling.
FreshFind does not provide live prices or confirm current stock. Use the directory to find markets that list the item, then contact traders to check today's price and availability.

Rivers State listings include Fruit Garden Market, Oil Mill Market, Mile 3 Market, and Creek Road Market in Port Harcourt. The directory lists commonly traded foods; current stock is not live-verified.
Plantain and banana are listed at several markets, including Fruit Garden Market in Port Harcourt. Availability varies by trader and season.
FreshFind lists fish and seafood at several markets, including Mile 3 and Creek Road in Port Harcourt. Check with traders for current catch and availability.
Yam, cassava, and garri are listed at markets in Rivers, Oyo, Enugu, Edo, and other locations. Use the product filter to narrow the directory.
Tomatoes, fresh pepper, and onions are listed at markets including Mile 12 in Lagos and several other state markets. Stock varies day to day.
Palm oil is listed at Oil Mill Market, Ogbete Main Market, Onitsha Main Market, and New Benin Market. Confirm availability and price locally.
Mile 12 International Market in Lagos is listed for vegetables, fruit, roots and tubers, and other food staples.
FreshFind lists markets in all 36 Nigerian states and the FCT, as well as selected markets in Ghana, Kenya, and South Africa. Use the directory filters to browse a specific location.
Tap the ☆ icon on any market card or produce item to bookmark it. You can view, export, or share your bookmarks from the Bookmarks panel in the header.
You can find our contact details and location on the Contact Us page.
FreshFind is a community project connecting residents with local farmers markets — more on the About Us page.
Allow location access on the Market Directory page and sort by 'Proximity' to see the closest markets to you.
